Collision

public boolean Collision(Point ps,
                         Point pe,
                         double dist)
Determines with the line from ps to pe intersects this safe zone.
Parameters:
ps - the starting location of a move
pe - the ending location of a move
dist - a bounding box delta that is used to minimize computation. If the bounding box of the move and this safe zone are within the given distance, then the move is intersected with the bounding box of this safe zone.
